title: Materia Bioworks Brand Guidelines
summary: A forward-thinking brand identity created for Materia Bioworks, a biotechnology company accelerating the commercialization of next-generation sustainable materials. The visual system balances scientific precision with modern innovation, establishing a trusted and scalable identity that reflects collaboration, advanced engineering, and a commitment to shaping a more sustainable future.
intent: Scientific precision made investable for a sustainable-materials company.
